hooks.name: Keep env docs in sync
hooks.description: Each app's env vars are validated in its config file and documented in docs/integration/environment.md. Changing .env.example without updating both leaves them out of sync.

action.prompt: An apps/*/.env.example file was saved. Compare its variables with the Zod schema in that app's src/app/config.ts (storefront, admin) or the reads in src/services/config.ts (mobile), and with docs/integration/environment.md. Update the docs or report mismatches. Variables prefixed VITE_ or EXPO_PUBLIC_ are public: warn if any looks like a secret, and never write real secret values anywhere.
